headline: BW LPG Reports $359 Million Net Profit for Third Quarter 2026
summary: Liquefied petroleum gas shipping firm BW LPG generated third-quarter net profit of $359 million and reported total available liquidity of $859 million.
why: BW LPG is the world's largest owner and operator of Very Large Gas Carriers, providing a operational baseline for maritime gas trade fundamentals.

impacts.name: BW LPG
impacts.why: Strong net earnings performance boosted corporate liquidity and return on equity metrics.
